theme_strategy: Light mode primary for data clarity (Enterprise LIMS standard), but featuring a rich, dark sidebar and warm accents that reflect the Caribbean Rum distillery identity.

headings.usage: Used for page titles (H1), widget headers, and key numeric KPIs. Provides a structured, modern enterprise feel with subtle character.

body.usage: Used for all data tables, inputs, and dense information. Ultimate legibility for numbers and technical specifications.

mono.usage: Used for sample IDs, QR codes, batch numbers, and SPC data.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp or slightly rounded corners (max rounded-md / 6px) to maintain an industrial, precise enterprise look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use shadow-sm for cards. Use a distinct shadow-lg with a warm tint for modals and dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle noise texture overlay to the dark sidebar to mimic aged oak/barrel wood.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)'. Separate main content sections and dashboard widgets with 1px solid borders (border-[#E6E2DC]) rather than floating cards, to maximize space and give an ERP density.

grids_layouts.app_structure: Left sidebar (w-64) for primary navigation (Dashboard, Samples, Catalog, Equipment, SPC). Top header (h-14) for global search, active batch context, and user profile.
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Top row: 4 KPI summary cards (col-span-1). Second row: Main SPC chart (col-span-3), Recent Alerts feed (col-span-1).
grids_layouts.spacing: Dense but legible. Use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids. Add generous padding (p-8) to the main page wrapper to let the dense data breathe.

component_style.buttons: Rectangular with subtle 4px radius. Primary buttons use the Amber/Gold brand color with dark text for high contrast.
component_style.tables: Shadcn UI tables heavily customized for density. Use smaller text (text-sm), tight padding (py-2), sticky headers, and row hover states (hover:bg-[#FCFCF9]).
component_style.forms: Left-aligned labels, crisp 1px borders on inputs, focus ring using the primary brand color.
component_style.badges: Square corners, solid or soft backgrounds for Sample Status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Blocked).
component_style.charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for SPC (Statistical Process Control) with upper/lower control limits clearly marked in red.

motion.transitions: Fast and crisp. 150ms ease-in-out for hover states.
motion.interactions: Highlight table rows on hover. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.loaders: Use skeleton screens for data tables instead of spinning loaders to maintain layout structure during data fetching.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA standards. Amber primary button MUST have dark text (#1A120E).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DCA54C] focus:ring-offset-1).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='sample-status-badge').

image_urls.description: Brown wooden barrels on floor. Use as a dark, atmospheric background for the Login page (with a heavy dark overlay) or as an empty state illustration.
Laboratory flask with amber liquid. Perfect visual accent for the 'Guided Testing' or 'Sample Reception' module headers.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Ensure solid backgrounds (like bg-white) for overlays.
Implement a layout structure with a fixed left sidebar and a scrollable main content area.
Prioritize data density and table design. Make tables look like a professional ERP (Odoo, SAP), not a spaced-out consumer app.
Ensure the application is fully responsive, though optimized for desktop (as is standard for lab workstations).
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Apply the typography classes correctly (e.g., font-sans for Outfit, font-serif/body for IBM Plex).
Integrate the brand colors provided to give the application a distinct 'Rum Distillery' personality while maintaining scientific rigor.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered generic layouts, simplistic gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements and crisp 1px borders.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, links, and key elements for testing.
Use Lucide icons, do not use emoji characters for icons.
